title: packet-dnp.c - Add Secure Authentication Object Support
description:
Added support for the following objects:
- Obj 4, Var3 : Double bit input change w/ Relative Time
- Obj 51, Var2 : Unsync'd Time and Date CTO.
- Obj 120, Var1 through to Var 15 (minus Var 8 and 14) : Authentication objects for SAv5 support
- Object 121/122, Var1: SA Security Statistics

commits_data.title: packet-dnp.c - Add Secure Authentication Object Support
commits_data.message:
packet-dnp.c - Add Secure Authentication Object Support

Added support for the following objects:
- Obj 4, Var3 : Double bit input change w/ Relative Time
- Obj 51, Var2 : Unsync'd Time and Date CTO.
- Obj 120, Var1 through to Var 15 (minus Var 8 and 14) : Authentication objects for SAv5 support
- Object 121/122, Var1: SA Security Statistics and Var2: SA Security Statistic Event w/ Time
